findings.claim: A causally consumed co-offer provenance field is omitted from the pinned beta trace.
findings.method: One authored matched pair: actual Workspace winner and same-key merge, actual Memory receive, actual Trace record. TypeScript transformed to JavaScript with import-path rewrites. The winning voice item is constant; treatment adds same-key percept provenance. No full Being run or live-specialist comparison.
findings.reproducibility: Underlying pinned modules remain restricted; the released observations are insufficient for independent execution without code access.

findings.claim: NativeActionForecasts updates a scoped Beta(1,1) command-exit estimate from matched receipts.
findings.method: Authored host-journal receipt sequence for a single exact command/workspace/deadline scope. No command was dispatched. No provider call.

findings.claim: The inspected curriculum cooldown ignores the recorded outcome and its private state is absent from snapshot/wake.
findings.method: Read resolveCurriculumPlan and NoveltyLedger.eligible; compare used fields with Heart.snapshot/wake and Snapshot schema. Eligibility consults fingerprint and beat distance, not complete/blocked/released. No new runtime experiment.
findings.qualification: Separate optional PerspectiveStore captures historical observations for specific app-server chat-tool families. It is not a general neutral-Resident outcome-to-body-learning adapter.
not_shown: fresh-process retention of the private cooldown
absence of every other persistence path in all repositories

findings.claim: Historical lab closure across action, delayed consequence, retained learning, checkpoint and reversal.

findings.limits: No rerun or sealed population released. Later V6-V8 work exposed robustness/identifiability limitations. Does not qualify current ordinary Resident integration.

findings.claim: A body-to-native-choice route exists but the tested cheap cue policy achieved more target selections.
findings.population: Six synthetic matched pairs in the supplied lab report; no uncertainty interval or population generalization asserted.
findings.limits: No new rerun; metrics do not measure consciousness or establish added task utility.

findings.claim: Richer and simpler memory selectors tied on the reported contract, with additional cost for the richer one.
findings.population: 360 scored checks over 40 authored synthetic identity-free histories.
findings.limits: These are contract checks, not 360 independent lives. No global claim about memory representations.

source_access: Company GitHub links may return 404 without authorization. Manuscript source register pins identities; no claim of open-code reproducibility.
